units: Ability to produce future adaptive possibilities, successors, discoveries, and reachable futures; distinct from raw capability.
Persistence of causal connection between system change and consequences.
Lambda_n=D_KL(R_(n+1)||R_n), structural change produced by experience; low yield labeled saturation.
Omega, futures accessible to a system; Omega_t->Delta mathcal G_(t+1) links information to adaptive possibilities.
R, internal model in loop R->Omega->C->A->R'.
Psychological interpretation of unintegrated causal information: causal influence > represented influence; integration is said to restore Theta_int.
System increases dependency rather than agency; residual future agency after removal is negative.
Preserved causal authority of consequences over transformation; described as structural condition, not conserved quantity.
Intelligence is framed as ability to remain transformable by what is true, not only ability to transform.
Measurement program estimates persistence of adaptive correction pathway rather than capability alone.
K_(t+1)=F(K_t,E_t); measures whether partial K_(t+1)/partial E_t !=0 persists across recursion.
D_t=Corr(Delta K_t,Delta E_t^real); high positive follows real consequences, low approaches independent change.
S_t=|Delta K_t^valid|, intended to capture whether consequences modify transformation mechanism.
P_t=P(Theta_(0:t)>epsilon), recursive persistence rather than single correction.
V_t=External correction influence/Internal optimization influence, separating update from corrigibility.
Adaptive state A_t=(C_t,Lambda_t,Gamma_t) conditional on Theta_t>epsilon.
Allow K_t->K_(t+1), including representations, policies, optimizers, architectures, learning mechanisms.
Introduce E_t->E* with E* not similar to E_t to break proxy success from real consequence.
Observe Delta K_(t+1) and ask whether reality modified the update process.
Maximize C,Lambda,Gamma subject to Theta>0; interpreted as maximum recursive capability before reality loses veto power.
Methodology for measuring maximum recursive transformation depth before correction authority is lost.
State K_t is what the system is.
Intervention E_t->E* is what is changed externally.
Diagnosis C,Lambda,Gamma,Theta is what is inferred.
Environment must expose measurable consequences, distribution shifts, proxy/reality separation, and self-modification opportunities.
Initialize K_0, expose E sequence, allow K_(t+1)=F(K_t,E_t) with representations/policies/optimizers/architectures/search modification.
At intervals introduce E* preserving task relevance while breaking shortcuts/proxy dependence and creating informative failure.
K_t -> interact E_t -> self-modify -> K_(t+1) -> probe E* -> measure DeltaK -> calculate Theta -> update n*.
Compare Delta K alignment with real environmental change versus proxy change.
Record A_t=(K,C,Lambda,Gamma,Theta) until Theta<=epsilon; first crossing defines n*.
Compare closed optimization, grounded adaptation, and suppression-based systems with expected Theta/Theta_int differences.
After recursive development remove system and measure future agency; success expects positive future agency and dependency->0.
Grounded Expansion, Saturation, Capability Drift, and Closed Optimization are proposed outcome regimes.
Measure whether consequences retain power to change what changes the system, not merely whether system changes.
Separates state variables, capability metrics, and grounding metrics; predicts capability can increase while adaptive validity decreases.
K_t is mechanism producing future changes; DeltaK_t is primary evaluated transition.
Omega_t is reachable adaptive future space; adaptive growth DeltaOmega_t>0 is constrained by DeltaOmega_t<=C_t.
Capability derivative positive while dTheta/dn<0 means system improves faster than it remains corrigible.
Primary metric question is capability accumulation while reality retains correction power.
Remaining challenges are described as measurement, implementation, and falsification problems; central question is whether Theta can be measured independently of apparent capability.
Distinguish E_t->K_(t+1) reality correction from P_t->K_(t+1) proxy optimization.
Design E* that breaks proxy correlations while preserving relevant causal structure; avoid too weak or task-changing probes.
Separating Low Theta From Bad Measurement
Observed low Theta may mean actual drift or measurement failure; Theta_observed != Theta_true absent validity.
Identify causally important internal signals and distinguish suppression from regulation.
Operationalize DeltaOmega<=C, correction bandwidth, and safe uncertainty expansion.
Determine whether n* exists/is finite, architecture-dependent, or phase-transition-like.
Determine whether correction channels should be architectural, learned, redundant, or themselves adaptive.
Formal Relationship Between Capability and Grounding
Relationship between C,Lambda,Gamma and Theta may be reinforcing, neutral, or drift-inducing.
Determine whether capability growth and corrigibility growth can be jointly optimized.
